rows.label: Corporation tax [national]
rows.value: 12.5% on trading income; 25% on non-trading income and excepted trades; 15% minimum effective rate (domestic top-up tax) for groups and standalone entities with revenue over €750,000,000. Paid by companies resident in Ireland, and non-resident companies trading through an Irish branch or agency. Taxes Consolidation Act 1997; Part 4A for the top-up taxes.

source.title: Revenue: Corporation Tax (CT), Basis of charge (published 16 October 2026); Corporation Tax (CT), Overview (published 16 October 2026)

rows.value: branch profits: corporation tax at the same rates; distributions: 25% Dividend Withholding Tax; close companies: 20% surcharge on undistributed investment and estate income (15% on half of professional and service income). Paid by companies (DWT is withheld from the shareholder's dividend). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 Part 6 Chapter 8A (DWT), sections 440 and 441 (surcharges).

rows.label: Self-employed contributions: PRSI Class S [national]
rows.value: 4.2% to 30 September 2026, 4.35% from 1 October 2026 (4.2375% for 2026 income in self-assessment), minimum €650. Paid by self-employed people with income of €5,000 or more. Social Welfare Consolidation Act 2005, Part 2 Chapter 3. In force from 1 January 2026.

rows.value: 0%, 20% or 35% withheld, by the subcontractor's tax compliance record. Paid by subcontractors in construction, forestry and meat processing (withheld by principal contractors). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 sections 530 to 530V.

rows.value: 20% withheld from fees. Paid by providers of professional services to state and semi-state bodies (withheld by the payer). Taxes Consolidation Act 1997 Part 18 Chapter 1.

source.title: Revenue: Professional Services Withholding Tax (PSWT), PSWT for accountable persons; Overview; What are professional services? (all published 17 September 2024); Tax and Duty Manual Part 18-01-04 (last updated November 2025)
